title: Application Integration — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Application Integration solution should meet the objective: Build a small JavaScript interface that reads a view function, requests a wallet-signed transaction, and renders an event/receipt status with correct pending and failed states. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
